states.metroNote: Most Delawareans live in the Philadelphia metro area, which includes Wilmington.
Johnson and Wyandotte counties put more Kansans in the Kansas City metro than in Wichita's.
Baltimore's metro narrowly outnumbers Maryland's part of the Washington, D.C. metro.
Kansas City is Missouri's largest city, but more Missourians live in the St. Louis metro.
Southern New Hampshire's Rockingham and Strafford counties are part of the Boston metro, narrowly outnumbering the Manchester–Nashua metro.
Most New Jerseyans live in the New York metro area, which includes Newark and Jersey City.
Columbus passed Cleveland; Cincinnati's metro is larger overall, but much of it is in Kentucky and Indiana.
Greenville–Anderson is the state's largest metro, though Charleston is the largest city.
Northern Virginia is part of the Washington, D.C. metro, home to more Virginians than Hampton Roads.
